name: product
description: Product discovery and definition before building: jobs to be done, hypotheses, success metrics, user flows, acceptance criteria in Given/When/Then and the scope of an MVP; end-to-end functional flows with their actors, decisions, exceptions and data; backlog refinement with INVEST, splitting and estimate proposals; work items for any tracker from an approved plan, with IDs checked against the project's ticket pattern; and outcome-based roadmaps with a one-page executive view. Diagrams and executive views use the executive style of the design pack in full when it is installed, and its neutral values otherwise.
